Hero_Desc_Velvet:
Among witches who strive for power she... will stop at nothing to attain it.
With her, there is a complete absence of pretense, which is somewhat necessary in social relationships.
Trouble always follows her due to her intense thirst for power.
Album_Like_Velvet: Showing off her strength. Stir-fried coconut and pine tree leaves.
Album_Hate_Velvet: Accidentally doing something foolish. Weak superiors.
Album_Hobby_Velvet: Bossing around witches lower than herself.
Album_Wish_Velvet: Having a kingdom of her own.
Album_Velvet1: A witch with an axe, and known as the most spirited among them, Velvet prefers confronting problems head on, albeit simplistic, which is counter to their reputation of plotting and scheming.
Album_Velvet2: Even so, she is a witch to the core. The problem is, her way of thinking is so simplistic, even the best-laid plans are easily foiled.
Album_Velvet3: Once Velvet perceives someone as 'on her side,' she, too, follows suit. Once, after helping her in a dispute with the other witches, she suddenly began giving me a variety of snacks.
Album_Velvet4: Curious about Velvet's behavior during night watch, I deliberately made her stand watch and pretended to sleep, while secretly observing her. She began to chop wood right above my head, at which point I just told her to go to sleep.
Album_Velvet5: One time, we encountered a formidable-looking enemy on a solitary road. Seeing as we couldn't overpower them, I thought diplomacy was the answer, when suddenly Velvet joined the enemy, and started glaring at me.
Album_Velvet6: If Velvet senses things are at a disadvantage, her betrayal is faster than the speed of light. And yet, once the situation is resolved, she always returns. When I try to say anything, she brushes it off, saying, 'Be cool. Let's just move on.'
Album_Velvet7: Velvet's simple and straightforward mannerisms might actually be her greatest strength. They make her seem clumsy or foolish, leading others to let their guards down. And that's exactly when Velvet strikes.

Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Hate1: Velvet went on a rampage, swinging her axe, accusing me of trying to give her heart disease from too much sugar.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Hate2:
Velvet called this food the ultimate lump of sugar, mocking it as the "apex" of sprite cuisine.
No sooner had she said it than she furiously trashed part of the restaurant.

Velvet liked the dish, saying it even looked healthy. 
After she finished eating, she wanted to test her strength and smashed the table.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like2: Velvet loved eating this. Watching her was surprisingly entertaining—I couldn't believe it worked.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like3: Disappointed when only looking at its appearance, she was surprised by the variety of flavors after taking a bite.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like4: Rather than eating as it is, she flattens it by punching it with her fists, then eats it. I don't know why she does that. And I don't really want to know.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like5: Velvet argued that such simple snacks aren't great for muscle growth but acknowledged the importance of vitamin intake, swallowing it in one gulp.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like6: Velvet complained that the food was too pretentious at first but, after taking a bite, her face turned red and she ended up eating it all.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like7: Velvet gave high marks for no sugar being added. She then poked me proudly with her thumb.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like8: Velvet said a protein chocolate bar would do. Then after grabbing one, she looked at me with puppy eyes asking if she could have more.
Food_ChefNote_Velvet_Like9: At first, Velvet discarded the candies saying they were made by Sprites. After trying one, she felt embarrassed and became silent.

LoveLetter_Velvet: Hey, Master!I've cooked up a genius plan to start my kingdom. Wanna join me? If it works, I'll make you my most trusted underling. You seem like someone I can count on. This time, I promise I won't betray you. I swear!Don't waste time replying; it's a pain to read. Catch you face-to-face soon.
LoveCall_Velvet:
Hmm, greetings, Master. It is I, Velvet.

Starting today, if you do not entrust an important position in the Order to me, I shall seize one by force. Understood?!

Huh? Did I make a prank call because I was bored? The great Velvet, Witch of Power, has no time to be bored! What do you take me for?!

...Well... I do have nothing to do at this exact moment. But I am not tremendously bored! Anyway, that is how it is!

I simply feel somewhat indebted... You always provide food for me in the banquet hall, so I should at least earn the cost of my meals!

I possess that much conscience, you know? I may look like a witch who constantly causes trouble and waits for a good position to fall into her lap... but that is because I have a dream!

Besides, I have caused very little trouble lately, right? Do you not feel the same way? If you do not, think about it again properly!

Ahem! Anyway! This is merely an ordinary call to ask how you are~ Something like that.

You are doing well... right? I am doing well too.

You must continue... doing well, understood? Ahem! Then I shall hang up.
